all.demand: Avery Santana — Mayor — Direct the Office of Economic and Workforce Development (OEWD) to clear the recruitment and intake bottlenecks flagged in the C102 executive review of the Oakland Youth Apprenticeship Pipeline (INIT-007).
all.sourceText:
## Avery Santana — Mayor

- **Agent:** `.claude/agents/civic-office-mayor/`
- **Address:** Direct the Office of Economic and Workforce Development (OEWD) to clear the recruitment and intake bottlenecks flagged in the C102 executive review of the Oakland Youth Apprenticeship Pipeline (INIT-007).
- **Why:** The program remains stalled with recruitment failures leading into the C104 findings report, requiring immediate executive intervention to unblock intake.
- **Acceptance:** An executive directive instructing the program team on specific intake adjustments to be evaluated in C104.
- **Silence consequence:** The apprenticeship pipeline will fail its pilot phase, leaving vulnerable youth without jobs and wasting allocated municipal resources.

all.demand: Avery Santana — Mayor — Transmit the formal INIT-007 Review Findings and Corrective Actions Report to City Council to resolve apprenticeship intake bottlenecks and stabilize executive policy direction following the 13-point approval drop in C104.
all.sourceText:
## Avery Santana — Mayor

- **Agent:** `.claude/agents/civic-office-mayor/`
- **Address:** Transmit the formal INIT-007 Review Findings and Corrective Actions Report to City Council to resolve apprenticeship intake bottlenecks and stabilize executive policy direction following the 13-point approval drop in C104.
- **Why:** The Oakland Youth Apprenticeship Pipeline (INIT-007) is scheduled for its C104 review findings deliverable after executive intervention in C103, coinciding with a drop in mayoral approval from 95 to 82 in C104.
- **Acceptance:** Public transmission of the INIT-007 corrective actions report containing revised intake targets and operational adjustments.
- **Silence consequence:** INIT-007 stalls in pilot phase without authorized corrective workflows, leaving municipal workforce commitments unmet.

- **Agent:** `.claude/agents/civic-office-mayor/`

all.sourceText:
## Avery Santana — Mayor

- **Agent:** `.claude/agents/civic-office-mayor/`
- **Address:** File legislative language for Downtown Economic Revitalization (INIT-008) and formalize executive execution on month-eight disbursements for INIT-001 and the design consultant contract for INIT-003.
- **Why:** The executive board carries 8 constituent complaints above the visibility threshold with zero filed legislative proposals, while seven initiatives (INIT-001, INIT-002, INIT-003, INIT-005, INIT-006, INIT-007, INIT-008) sit at the C110 stall-clock deadline; INIT-008 missed its C108 filing milestone.

- **Silence consequence:** Citywide capital sequencing bottlenecks across seven active initiatives, leaving Downtown commercial corridors without statutory relief and stalling pre-development citywide.

all.sourceText:
## Avery Santana — Mayor

- **Agent:** `.claude/agents/civic-office-mayor/`
- **Address:** File legislative text for INIT-009 and INIT-010 with the City Clerk and docket formal administrative responses to the three standing citizen petitions.
- **Why:** INIT-009 (Commercial Stabilization for Grand Lake) and INIT-010 (West Oakland Tenant Defense Fund) were announced with legislation-filed milestones set for C110 and sit unfiled heading into the C112 stall threshold, while three verified citizen petitions have crossed the visibility line with no executive proposal introduced.
- **Acceptance:** Formal filing of draft ordinances for INIT-009 and INIT-010, alongside a recorded mayoral action on the three pending petition items in C112.
- **Silence consequence:** Both initiatives lapse into administrative stall under charter tracking, and executive inaction on verified citizen petitions becomes the city record.

all.sourceText:
## Avery Santana — Mayor

- **Agent:** `.claude/agents/civic-office-mayor/`
- **Address:** Transmit responsive legislative proposals for the 7 citizen complaints on the executive ledger and file the charter renewal ordinance for the West Oakland Stabilization Fund (INIT-001).
- **Why:** The mayoral petition pool has grown to 7 unresolved complaints—more than double the charter visibility line of 3—with no proposals filed, while INIT-001 completed Month-12 disbursement in C114 and requires charter renewal legislation before its C115 stall clock lapses.
- **Acceptance:** Formal legislative filings responding to the 7 citizen petitions and a transmitted INIT-001 charter renewal proposal on the council docket in C115.
- **Silence consequence:** Executive default under municipal petition rules and programmatic expiration of West Oakland's primary stabilization vehicle at the close of its twelve-month disbursement cycle.

facts: The A's parade roll through Downtown.

The Oakland A's celebrated their 7th World Series championship in the Paulson era with a parade and rally in Downtown. Despite the colder temps the Oakland citizens were out in masses to honor their beloved A's. Mike Paulson , Vinnie Keane, Benji Dillon all stood a front the double decker bus cheering and waving to their fans. Darrin Davis, Isley Kelley, and Mark Aitken all laughing and celebrating together to what may likely have a much different feel with Keane and Dillon retiring and Aitken pending free agency unknown. Manager Deacon Seymour and rookie phenon Ernestor Quintero were seen throwing A's beads into the crowd. Playoff MVP Eric Taveras and A's ace Arturo Ramos taking selfie snapshots with fans and dancing with the crowds. The parade ran through Downtown and Jake London Square. After a season of near perfection, the city of Oakland celebrates together, the choices for the direction for next season remain unclear in a few areas but what can be expected is yet another run and the pursuit if championship number 8.
A's win their 7th championship in the "Paulson" era. A storybook ending to a farewell season for both Vinnie Keane and Benji Dillon

The Oakland A's won their 7th championship in the Paulson era lead by stars like Vinnie Keane, Benji Dillon, Mark Aitken, Isley Kelley, Darrin Davis. In a farewell season that will see 2 retire Vinnie Keane and Benji Dillon, 1 potentially leave in free agency Mark Aitken, and 2 remaining to further carry the franchise to the next era Isely Kelley and Darrin Davis. In a seaon where the A's absolutely dominated breaking the single season win records and then only losing 3 games in its playoff run, the A's don't appear as a team on the decline, However with a franchise that AAA team also won its championship, the A's are eager to see the young prospects emerge. But for now the fans of the A's can just rejoice in the perfection the season played out to be. Eric Taveras win World Series MVP to go along with his post-season MVP for the earlier rounds, Taveras showing tremendous value in signing him this past off-season. Pablo Alamanzar continued to show tremendous potential with a no hitter in his MLB debut and then a 1-hitter in his playoff debut and following that up with a game 3 win in the World Series. Arturo Ramos stayed consistent throughout the playoff as well. Championship parade is set for Downtown in c111.
